text: と　かかれた　ペナントは　ないのかね？

structure.jp: と　かかれた　ペナントは
structure.en: pennants with that written on them

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と points back at the words just said, here the words printed on the item in the line before. と かかれた = 'with "..." written on it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: かく changed to かかれる turns 'write' into 'be written'. Placed before ペナント it describes the pennant. かかれた ペナント = 'a pennant that has it written on it'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか asks for an explanation, often with surprise or disappointment. ね makes it an older man's gentle question. ないのかね = 'so you don't have any?'.
